activation.note: Activation covers declarations, references, uses, contract changes and findings on existing names; it is not limited to renames or new artifacts. Path globs are explicitly illustrative rather than exclusive gates. Task/path observations are available directly, while diff extraction and validation findings honestly require new observers. Inferred activation details are declared in additions.

audit.summary: All 16 segments survive at their claimed destinations, with the naming constraints available to the coder and provenance retained in audit. The single umbrella validation obligation retains all three source categories; authored rationale and activation details are declared, with no waivers or shared-node relocation.

segmentChecks.note: The then field retains the umbrella requirement that artifact names pass format, semantic, and technical validation.
The format constraints are complete in prefer[0]: lowercase separator-free theme, kebab-case category/aspect/variant, colon descent, and dot variants.
All semantic constraints survive across prefer and avoid, including exact URN/name matching and avoidance of deep variant nesting.
The technical constraints retain contract existence, the contracts/{segments}.schema.json location, splitting on colon and dot, exact $id construction, and identical consumer references.
The validation_rule term identifier is retained explicitly in verifier_detail[0].
Verifier_detail[0] preserves the definition as a format/semantic/technical constraint on artifact names.

risks: The coder-facing fields do not specify how split name segments are joined into the contract path, so a weak coder could invent the wrong directory layout.
The approved taxonomy is referenced but not identified or located, leaving theme membership without an actionable lookup.
Deep variant nesting and whether each hierarchy level adds value have no decision procedure or threshold, making those semantic checks subjective.

unobservable: change: diff-level extraction of declared/referenced artifact names and contract file/path or $id changes needs a new observer
finding: artifact-name-validation-failure reports from a validator or review need a new observer

review.summary: The sampled knowledge-rich segments are preserved at their claimed destinations, and no dropped, shared, or auditor-rejected segments require re-judgment. The rewrite is faithful and merits PASS, although weak-coder usability is limited by unspecified path joining and semantic criteria; activation also depends on explicitly declared new observers.
